seoTitle: Atlanta Public Schools Calendar 2027–28: Key Dates and Downloads
seoDescription: See key Atlanta Public Schools 2027–28 dates, including the first and last days, major breaks, the early-release day, the official PDF, and a calendar download.
heroSummary: Atlanta Public Schools starts the 2027–28 school year on Monday, August 2, 2027, and ends it on Friday, May 26, 2028. Fall Break runs October 12–15, Thanksgiving Break runs November 22–26, and Spring Break runs April 3–7. APS has one districtwide PreK–12 early-release day, on September 20. After December Break, students return on Tuesday, January 4; January 3 is a teacher professional learning day.
calendarNotes: The official APS 2027–28 student calendar lists 180 instructional days: 88 in the first semester and 92 in the second. The calendar includes one PreK–12 Early Release Day on September 20 and teacher professional learning days on October 11, November 2, January 3, February 21, and March 20.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the APS early-release day in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: APS has one PreK–12 early-release day in 2027–28: Monday, September 20, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Do students attend on teacher professional learning days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Students are off on October 11, November 2, January 3, February 21, and March 20. These dates are teacher professional learning days rather than named school breaks.

calendarFaqs.q: When do students return after December Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, January 4, 2028. Monday, January 3 is a teacher professional learning day, so students do not attend.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded calendar update automatically if APS changes a date?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and will not update automatically if APS revises its calendar. Check the official APS calendar page for later changes.

customSections.content: Pay particular attention to the early-release day, teacher professional learning days, and the January return date.

groups.label: Attendance and dismissal changes
items: Students attend school but are dismissed earlier than usual on September 20. Check your school's dismissal, bus, and after-school program schedule.
Students do not attend on October 11, November 2, January 3, February 21, or March 20. These are teacher professional learning days rather than part of a named school break.

groups.label: Break names and return dates
items: APS calls the late-December holiday period "December Break" and the February closure "Winter Break." Students return from December Break on Tuesday, January 4.
